sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Tahquamenon Falls State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483348: /api/maps + /api/resourcelocation/resources, map 'Lower Falls - Hemlock')

values.note: DNR rate table, Lower Falls-Hemlock: $41 with 20/30-amp, $46 with 50-amp; semi-modern rates $36 (20/30-amp) and $41 (50-amp) apply when the loop is semi-modern. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Tahquamenon Falls / Lower Falls-Hemlock: Modern 50 AMP $46, Modern 20/30 AMP $41, Semi-modern 50 AMP $41, Semi-modern $36; season Year-round) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Recreation Passport required for vehicle entry), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground: 'All sites have 30-amp service, and some 50-amp sites are available') + midnrreservations.com map 'Lower Falls - Hemlock' (88 campsites, all 'Electric Only', 22 with 50 Amps, Sewer Hookup 'No' on all), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 88 campsites on the booking site's 'Hemlock' loop map (the DNR counts 188 for the whole Lower Falls Modern Campground, Hemlock and Portage together); 7 pull-throughs; pad lengths 25-105 ft, most 30-45 ft.

sites.source: midnrreservations.com map 'Lower Falls - Hemlock' (88 campsites, Pull Through Yes 7, Site Length) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('Number of sites: 188', 'Pull-through sites available'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground: 'Modern campground', 'Toilet & shower building', 'A sanitation station is available seasonally'; 'sanitation stations located at Lower Falls Modern Campground ... open seasonally mid-May to mid-October. Each has potable water') + DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls (Lower Falls Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tahquamenonfalls ('The Hemlock loop ... is open year-round', 'The accessible toilet and shower building is open year-round') + DNR rates table (Lower Falls-Hemlock: Year-round - Year-round), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed fees $36 (semi-modern) to $46 (50-amp) with the Recreation Passport in fees.note, and year-round operation (Hemlock loop and its toilet/shower building open all year). Added 50-amp (22 of 88 sites; all have 30-amp), no water/sewer at sites, 88 campsites with 7 pull-throughs (pads 25-105 ft), modern facilities with a seasonal sanitation station, reservable on midnrreservations.com. --AWH note kept (DNR: the loop is about a mile from the Lower Falls). Not stated: max rig length, booking window/max stay for this park (left inherited).
